class.name: DSTextureCache
class.brief_description: Thread-safe least-recently-used cache for DirectStorage textures.
class.description: [DSTextureCache] provides an optional thread-safe least-recently-used (LRU) cache for loaded [Texture2D] resources. The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSTextureCache"[/code]. When enabled, the resource loader can query and store textures according to the requested cache mode ([constant CACHE_MODE_REUSE], [constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE], or [constant CACHE_MODE_REPLACE]).

method.name: add_alias
method.description: Binds [param alias_path] as an alias pointing to the canonical cached entry for [param canonical_path] without consuming an additional cache slot.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every cached texture and unbinds all aliases, releasing the underlying GPU [RenderingDevice] texture resources for unreferenced entries while safely preserving GPU resources for textures held externally ([code]ref_count > 1[/code]). [b]Note:[/b] While [method clear] preserves GPU resources for textures still held by active materials or scripts, it empties the cache lookup table entirely. Subsequent requests for previously cached textures will miss the cache and reload from storage. Use [method clear_unused] to safely evict idle textures during active gameplay while keeping in-use textures cached, reserving [method clear] for full scene transitions or shutdown.

method.name: clear_unused
method.description: Scans the cache and evicts only textures that are not held by any external reference ([code]ref_count == 1[/code]), destroying their GPU resources while leaving textures in active use by visible scenes, materials, or scripts intact. Unbinds associated aliases for evicted entries. Returns the number of evicted textures.

method.name: evict
method.description: Removes the cached texture stored under [param path] (or its canonical entry if [param path] is an alias) and unbinds associated aliases.

method.name: get_cached
method.description: Returns the cached texture for [param path] (resolving any alias to its canonical entry) and marks it as recently used unless [param cache_mode] ignores or replaces caching. Returns [code]null[/code] when no entry exists or caching is disabled.

method.name: get_canonical_path
method.description: Returns the canonical path for [param path]. If [param path] is an alias, returns the canonical primary path it points to; if it is already canonical, returns [param path]; otherwise returns an empty string.

method.name: get_cached_count
method.description: Returns the number of textures currently cached.

method.name: get_max_entries
method.description: Returns the maximum number of entries retained by the cache.

method.name: get_pending_prewarm_count
method.description: Returns the number of prewarm textures for [param tag] with at least one unfinished stream request. Pass [code]0[/code] (the default) to count every tag. Compare with [method get_unbuilt_prewarm_count], which counts textures still awaiting [method poll_completed] regardless of request state.

method.name: get_unbuilt_prewarm_count
method.description: Returns the number of prewarm textures for [param tag] still held by the preloader and awaiting [method poll_completed]. Pass [code]0[/code] (the default) to count every tag. Reaching [code]0[/code] means every terminal request has been built and stored.

method.name: get_unbuilt_cpu_prewarm_count
method.description: Returns the number of CPU memory prewarm textures for [param tag] awaiting background [method poll_completed] decompression into ImageTexture. Used by DSBatchManager to avoid scheduling worker ingestion tasks when all pending items are GPU textures.

method.name: get_unbuilt_gpu_prewarm_count
method.description: Returns the number of direct GPU DMA prewarm textures for [param tag] awaiting main-thread [method poll_completed] wrapping into Texture2DRD.

method.name: is_cache_mode_ignored
method.description: Returns whether the given [param cache_mode] specifies bypassing cache storage and lookup ([constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE] or [constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE_DEEP]).

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the texture cache is actively enabled.

method.name: is_gpu_prewarm_available
method.description: Returns whether hardware GPU DirectStorage prewarming is currently available (requires an initialized D3D12 DirectStorage backend with GPU decompression enabled and a live D3D12 [RenderingDevice]).

method.name: poll_completed
method.description: Builds finished prewarm textures and stores them in the cache under their engine path. Only requests matching [param tag] are processed; pass [code]0[/code] (the default) to poll every tag. When [param max_items] is greater than [code]0[/code], at most that many textures are built by this call. When [param max_usec] is greater than [code]0[/code], building yields once elapsed microseconds exceed the budget, keeping per-frame ingestion cost bounded. Returns the number of textures stored by this call. Failed or cancelled requests are skipped here and load normally later through the regular loader.

method.name: prewarm_async
method.description: Enqueues engine texture paths for asynchronous streaming prewarm and returns the stream tag. File remapping is resolved internally, and paths already in the cache are skipped without enqueueing. Track the tag with [method DSContext.is_prewarm_complete] and [method DSContext.get_prewarm_progress], or stop it early with [method DSContext.cancel_prewarm]. Returns [code]0[/code] when the extension is unavailable.

method.name: prewarm_gpu_async
method.description: Enqueues engine texture paths for GPU-accelerated asynchronous streaming prewarm and returns the stream tag. When running under the D3D12 rendering driver with GPU decompression enabled, eligible color textures (v2 format, color-sampled, without the as_image_texture flag) are allocated directly as [Texture2DRD] resources on the render thread and filled via DirectStorage DMA decompression straight into VRAM. Ineligible textures or non-D3D12 platforms automatically fall back to the CPU [ImageTexture] memory stream path under the same stream tag. Textures are allocated in render-thread chunks of [param chunk_size] (default 16) to bound frame time. Returns [code]0[/code] when the extension is unavailable.

method.name: pump_gpu_prewarm
method.description: Dispatches at most one queued GPU prewarm allocation chunk to the render thread per call. Automatically ticked once per frame by [code]DSBatchManager[/code]. Safe to call manually; no-op when idle or when a chunk is already in flight.

method.name: has_alias
method.description: Returns whether [param alias_path] is currently registered as an alias in the cache.

method.name: remove_alias
method.description: Unbinds [param alias_path] from its canonical cached entry without removing the canonical texture itself.

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables the texture cache. Disabling the cache clears all currently retained entries.

method.name: set_max_entries
method.description: Sets the cache capacity. Values less than [code]1[/code] are clamped to [code]1[/code]; excess oldest entries are evicted immediately. Entries still held outside the cache are skipped during eviction, so the cache can temporarily exceed capacity rather than freeing a texture that is still in use.

method.name: store
method.description: Stores [param texture] under [param path] (optionally registering [param alias_path] as a shared secondary key without consuming extra capacity) and marks it as recently used if caching is enabled and [param cache_mode] is not ignored. Null textures are ignored.

members.member: Whether the texture cache is enabled. When disabled, queries return [code]null[/code] and new entries are not stored.
Maximum number of textures retained by the least-recently-used cache.

constants.constant: Queries the cache and stores the loaded texture if caching is enabled.
Bypasses cache lookup and updates or replaces the existing cache entry.
Bypasses caching for this resource and any nested sub-resources.
